description: A line under a general affine map (mixed rotation, scale, shear and translation), carried as a four-level INSERT chain: a translation, then the rotation, non-uniform scale and rotation of the 2x2 part's singular value decomposition. A single INSERT cannot store the map, the chain reaches the same world-space line. The angles and scales are derived values (tools/authoring/chain_svd.py), compared under PVec numeric policy v1 and not exact.
